arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from parse import compile

# More comprehensive edge case testing
test_cases = [
    # Should work
    ('{}', True),
    ('{name}', True),
    ('{{}}', True),
    ('{{', True),
    ('}}', True),
    ('{{ }}', True),
    ('a{}b', True),
    ('{{a}}', True),  # This is {{ then a then }}
    
    # Should fail
    ('{world', False),
    ('world}', False),
    ('{', False),
    ('}', False),
    ('hello {', False),
    ('} hello', False),
    ('hel{lo', False),
    ('hello}world', False),
    ('{{{', False),
    ('{foo}}', False),
]

print('Comprehensive edge case testing:')
for pattern, should_work in test_cases:
    try:
        p = compile(pattern)
        if should_work:
            print(f'  OK: {pattern!r:20} -> compiled successfully')
        else:
            print(f'  ERROR: {pattern!r:20} -> should have failed but compiled')
    except ValueError as e:
        if not should_work:
            print(f'  OK: {pattern!r:20} -> raised ValueError')
        else:
            print(f'  ERROR: {pattern!r:20} -> unexpected ValueError: {e}')
"
